command:
env | grep -i '^GIT' ; echo "---repro git-format patch inside repo"; D="$(mktemp -d /workspace/.eval/tmp/ga.XXXXXX)"; R="$D/toy"; git init -q "$R"; mkdir -p "$R/tools"; printf 'a
' > "$R/tools/x.txt"; git -C "$R" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t add -A; git -C "$R" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm one; printf 'b
' > "$R/tools/x.txt"; git -C "$R" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qam two; git -C "$R" -c diff.noprefix=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-renames --src-prefix=a/ --dst-prefix=b/ HEAD~1 HEAD -- tools/x.txt > "$D/p.patch"; cat "$D/p.patch"; mkdir -p "$D/ref/tools"; printf 'a
' > "$D/ref/tools/x.txt"; (cd "$D/ref" && git apply -p1 "$D/p.patch"; echo "exit=$?"; echo "content: $(cat tools/x.txt)"); echo "--- same, cwd under a gitignored path? check:"; git -C /workspace check-ignore -v "$D/ref/tools/x.txt" || echo "not ignored"; git -C /workspace status --porcelain --ignored -- .eval 2>/dev/null | head -3
